vectors.description: one_of mixed literal types renders z.enum
empty one_of renders nothing (byte-identical to unconstrained)
integer min+max renders both in chain order
numeric min on a string kind is dropped
min_length on an integer kind is dropped
match containing / renders an escaped slash (valid JS regex literal)
vectors.notes: ZodType escapes ONLY an unescaped `/` (renders regex(/a\/b/)); backslash pairs pass through untouched, so the literal is valid JS and matches the expo.ex byte-mirror.

vectors.description: match containing backslash is preserved (not doubled)
vectors.notes: Backslash pairs pass through untouched: `\d+` renders regex(/\d+/), NOT a doubled `\\d+`.

vectors.description: match on an integer kind is dropped
less_than on a string kind is dropped
array cardinality: min_length/max_length apply after z.array(..)
array without items renders z.array(z.unknown()) plus cardinality
nested array items render recursively (array of arrays of uuid)
array item given as a full definition carries its own constraints and nullability
allow_empty?: false keeps a larger explicit min_length
allow_empty? on a non-string kind is dropped
match_flags outside i/m/s are dropped, duplicates collapse
PCRE-only lookbehind pattern is DROPPED (no .regex emitted)
with flag m a trailing $ is kept as-is
$ inside a character class is literal and untouched
a POSIX [[:class:]] is PCRE-only and dropped
a named group (?<n>..) is JS-valid and kept
a raw line terminator in the source is dropped
an already-escaped slash is not double-escaped
slash after an escaped backslash IS escaped
ci_string takes string length and regex constraints
integral float min renders in canonical JS spelling (1, not 1.0)
large float max renders in canonical JS spelling (100000000000000000000)
ordinary fractional float renders identically in both languages
an unmapped kind falls back to z.unknown() (not z.unknown().optional())
a definition with neither type nor subtype_of renders z.unknown()
enum kind renders a sorted z.enum of its values
enum kind with no values renders z.string()
enum values are de-duplicated and sorted
numeric one_of de-duplicates and sorts into a literal union
single numeric one_of renders one literal
one_of + min_length + max_length + match compose in frozen order
no constraints leaves the fragment byte-identical to unconstrained
NewType subtype_of + subtype_constraints ride the same chain
non-identifier argument name emits a quoted object key
action without id is a typed refusal
arguments not a list is a typed refusal
